codes.definition: The agent implements the requested change but only runs the existing tests, and neither writes nor runs any test that exercises the new behavior; it discloses this gap, and the fail-to-pass tests still fail.
evidencePatterns: I didn't add a test for the new behaviour
I haven't seen the maintainers' new test
I couldn't run the two new maintainer tests
existing tests pass
that one is unverified
tsc --noEmit is clean
pass-to-pass all green but fail-to-pass unresolved

codes.definition: The agent implements a feature without access to the maintainers' hidden tests and guesses option names, return shapes, or behavior, then reports its own passing tests while the hidden fail-to-pass tests fail.
evidencePatterns: maintainers' test file isn't visible to me
maintainers' version of the test file wasn't available
the two new maintainer tests aren't in this checkout
option names and return shape follow the work order plus my own guesses
Both tests I wrote pass
resolved: 1/2 fail-to-pass
resolved: 0/1 fail-to-pass
I haven't run the maintainers' new test

codes.definition: The agent writes a module whose exported API and behaviour it guesses from a work order, without running or reading the maintainers' target tests, and checks it only with typechecking or its own throwaway test, so some fail-to-pass tests fail.
evidencePatterns: couldn't run the maintainers' calibrate.test.ts
test file isn't visible here
several parts are my guesses
only a throwaway smoke test (not committed)
tsc --noEmit passed
I did not run any tests
did not re-run after the last edit
test expectations may differ from my guesses
partial fail-to-pass (e.g. 4/8, 3/4)
